# Threatbase

> Threatbase is a free, community-driven threat-intelligence platform that
> publishes continuously refreshed IOC feeds (IP, IPv6, CIDR, domain, URL, hash)
> and an indicator-lookup API at https://threatbase.qzz.io.

Feeds are aggregated from public sources plus community reports, deduplicated,
scored for risk, and republished in plain text. False positives reported by the
community are suppressed before publication, not filtered client-side.

## Public IOC feeds

Free. No token, no signup, no attribution required. Served same-origin from
`https://threatbase.qzz.io/ioc/`, refreshed continuously. Live counts are in
[stats.json](https://threatbase.qzz.io/ioc/data/stats.json); chunk names and
byte sizes are in [manifest.json](https://threatbase.qzz.io/ioc/data/manifest.json).

| Feed | URL | Lines |
|---|---|---|
| IPv4 | `https://threatbase.qzz.io/ioc/ip/threatbase-ip.txt` | `IP,FeedCount,RiskScore,Tags,FirstSeen,LastSeen,Sources` |
| IPv6 | `https://threatbase.qzz.io/ioc/ip/threatbase-ipv6.txt` | `value,date` |
| CIDR | `https://threatbase.qzz.io/ioc/ip/threatbase-cidr.txt` | `value,date` |
| Domain | `https://threatbase.qzz.io/ioc/domain/threatbase-domain-01.txt` | `value,date` |
| URL | `https://threatbase.qzz.io/ioc/url/threatbase-url.txt` | `value,date` |
| Hash | `https://threatbase.qzz.io/ioc/hash/threatbase-hash-01.txt` | `value,date` |

The domain and hash feeds are split into numbered chunks (`-01`, `-02`, …) to stay
under GitHub's per-file limits. Enumerate them from `manifest.json` rather than
assuming a chunk count; the chunk set changes.

**Do not hardcode a chunk count.** The unsplit domain and hash feeds are published
only as GitHub release assets on the `latest` tag — requesting the unsplit names
from this domain returns 404 by design.

## Indicator lookup API

Public documentation: https://threatbase.qzz.io/api

- `GET /api/v1/scan?indicator=<value>` — look up one indicator.
- `GET /api/lookup` — raw lookup across the corpus.
- `GET /api/geo`, `GET /api/rdap` — enrichment for an IP or domain.
- `POST /api/v1/report` — report an indicator. Requires a Pro API key.
- `POST /api/community-report` — unauthenticated community submission, Turnstile-gated.

## Threatbase Pro

Pro adds per-category feeds, firewall-ready formats (ipset, nftables, STIX 2.1)
and a bulk scan endpoint. Feed access is token-gated:

`https://threatbase.qzz.io/feed/<token>/<path>`

Requests without a valid token are rejected at the edge. Pro content is not
mirrored to any public repository or CDN — the token is the only door.

## Security and acceptable use

- Vulnerability disclosure: see https://threatbase.qzz.io/.well-known/security.txt
- Report abuse or a false positive: mailto:threatbasepro@gmail.com
- Automated access to the free feeds is welcome. Respect rate limits, send a
  descriptive `User-Agent`, and cache what you fetch — these files are large and
  change at most hourly.
- Enumerating Pro feed tokens, probing `/api/admin/*`, or otherwise attempting to
  reach data without authorization is not permitted. Requests are logged with
  source address, user agent and timestamp, and may be reported.
